submitted.rationale: With only 3 merit measurements, I sampled the ZnSb2O6-trirutile region (idx 16: 0.070% EQE), an intermediate Zn-rich point (idx 4: 0.195%) and the Zn7Sb2O12-spinel end (idx 0: 0.119%). Index 4 (Sb 0.32) had the highest measured EQE, which points to a peak somewhere in the intermediate Zn-rich range.
